ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, ABCDEF is a convex hexagon, and the vertices form the outer boundary in the order A-B-C-D-E-F. Point G is near the interior, BG is approximately horizontal to the right, GF slopes toward the upper right, and GD slopes toward the lower right. In the figure, the three parallelograms ABGF, CDGB, and EFGD share point G. From parallelogram ABGF, it can be known that AB ∥ GF, and BG and GB are on the same straight line. Therefore the given ∠ABG = 53° can be transferred as: the angle between GF and the horizontal line from G to the right is 53°. From parallelogram CDGB, it can be known that CD ∥ BG, and DG and GD are on the same straight line. The given ∠CDG = 56° corresponds near point G to: the angle between GD and the horizontal line from G to the right is 56°, located below the horizontal line. Therefore at point G, ray GF is 53° above the horizontal line, and ray GD is 56° below the horizontal line, so ∠FGD = 53° + 56° = 109°. In parallelogram EFGD, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, and ∠EFG and ∠FGD are adjacent interior angles, so ∠EFG = 180° - 109° = 71°.

raw_record.question_text: Parallelograms $ABGF$, $CDGB$, and $EFGD$ are drawn so that $ABCDEF$ is a convex hexagon, as shown. If $\angle ABG = 53^o$ and $\angle CDG = 56^o$, what is the measure of $\angle EFG$, in degrees?

method.method_draft: Use an angle chase centered at G. From the image, note the order of the convex hexagon A-B-C-D-E-F and that the three parallelograms share the interior point G, with BG drawn horizontally, GF slanting up-right, and GD slanting down-right. From the text, ABGF, CDGB, and EFGD are parallelograms, so AB ∥ GF, BG ∥ AF, CD ∥ BG, DG ∥ CB, and EF ∥ DG. Since AB ∥ GF and BG is the same line as GB, the given angle ∠ABG = 53° transfers to the angle between ray GF and the rightward horizontal through G. Since CD ∥ BG and DG is the same direction as the lower slanted side, ∠CDG = 56° transfers to the angle between ray GD and the rightward horizontal through G, on the other side. Therefore ∠FGD = 53° + 56° = 109°. In parallelogram EFGD, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, so ∠EFG = 180° − 109° = 71°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像中，ABCDEF 是一个凸六边形，顶点按 A-B-C-D-E-F 的顺序围成外边界。点 G 在内部附近，BG 近似水平向右，GF 向右上方倾斜，GD 向右下方倾斜。图中由 ABGF、CDGB、EFGD 三个平行四边形共享点 G。

由平行四边形 ABGF 可知 AB ∥ GF，且 BG 与 GB 在同一直线上。因此给定的 ∠ABG = 53° 可以转移为：GF 与从 G 向右的水平线之间的夹角为 53°。

由平行四边形 CDGB 可知 CD ∥ BG，且 DG 与 GD 在同一直线上。给定的 ∠CDG = 56° 对应到点 G 附近就是：GD 与从 G 向右的水平线之间的夹角为 56°，位于水平线下方。

所以在点 G 处，射线 GF 在水平线上方 53°，射线 GD 在水平线下方 56°，因此
∠FGD = 53° + 56° = 109°。

在平行四边形 EFGD 中，相邻内角互补，∠EFG 与 ∠FGD 是相邻内角，所以
∠EFG = 180° - 109° = 71°。

method.method_draft: Draw or imagine an auxiliary straight line through F parallel to BG and CD. From the image, F is the top-right vertex, FG points down-left toward G, and FE points down-right toward E, so this auxiliary line passes through F between the two transferred angle references. From ABGF being a parallelogram, FG ∥ AB; hence the angle between FG and the leftward ray of the auxiliary line equals the given ∠ABG = 53°. From EFGD and CDGB, FE ∥ GD and CD ∥ BG; hence the angle between FE and the rightward ray of the auxiliary line equals the given ∠CDG = 56°. Along the straight line through F, the lower half-plane angle is 180°, split into 53°, ∠EFG, and 56°. Thus ∠EFG = 180° − 53° − 56° = 71°.

推理：按照方法，过 F 作一条辅助直线，使它平行于 BG 和 CD。因为 ABGF 是平行四边形，所以 FG ∥ AB；又辅助线 ∥ BG，因此在 F 处，FG 与辅助线左向射线所成的角等于 ∠ABG = 53°。因为 EFGD 是平行四边形，所以 FE ∥ GD；又 CDGB 是平行四边形，所以 CD ∥ BG，辅助线也 ∥ CD。因此在 F 处，FE 与辅助线右向射线所成的角等于 ∠CDG = 56°。在过 F 的这条直线下方，三个相邻角分别是 53°、∠EFG、56°，它们组成平角 180°。所以 ∠EFG = 180° - 53° - 56° = 71°。

raw_record.final_cot:
In the image, ABCDEF is a convex hexagon, and the vertices form the outer boundary in the order A-B-C-D-E-F. Point G is near the interior, BG is approximately horizontal to the right, GF slopes toward the upper right, and GD slopes toward the lower right. In the figure, the three parallelograms ABGF, CDGB, and EFGD share point G.

From parallelogram ABGF, it can be known that AB ∥ GF, and BG and GB are on the same straight line. Therefore the given ∠ABG = 53° can be transferred as: the angle between GF and the horizontal line from G to the right is 53°.

From parallelogram CDGB, it can be known that CD ∥ BG, and DG and GD are on the same straight line. The given ∠CDG = 56° corresponds near point G to: the angle between GD and the horizontal line from G to the right is 56°, located below the horizontal line.

Therefore at point G, ray GF is 53° above the horizontal line, and ray GD is 56° below the horizontal line, therefore
∠FGD = 53° + 56° = 109°.

In parallelogram EFGD, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, and ∠EFG and ∠FGD are adjacent interior angles, so
∠EFG = 180° - 109° = 71°.
